SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Everyone else has accepted our relationship.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ayase, Saori, Kuroneko, Mom and Dad...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] They all gave us their blessings.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] The only one left is you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] In that case, all the more reason for me not to 
accept it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I have to object... on everyone else's behalf as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Why are you being like that...?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You've always been like that, since the past!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] You always, always, always, always interfered every 
single time...!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...It can't be helped if you think of me that way.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...I have no ill intentions, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I understand that!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Mana-chan is super nice! You always think about us 
the most!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] You put aside all of your own feelings and wishes, 
put yourself at a disadvantage all alone, working for 
the sake of everyone's happiness...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I already understand that!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] But, still...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...I'm sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] I like him! I like him, I like him, I 
like him, I like him... [font_size=33]I just like him![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] I love my Onii-chan...  [font_size=33]I love 
Kyousuke!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] I definitely won't regret it! If you think I'm lying, 
then just keep watching me from now onwards!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] *sigh*

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ahaha... Just as I thought, it's useless.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I understand how you two feel... the feelings of the 
people that accepted your relationship, and of the 
girls that decided to support you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] It's really unfair, isn't it...? Something like being 
unrelated by blood.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] It makes me think, "How frustrating. If only it 
weren't for this."

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...You'll accept our relationship?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] No way.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] You can't persuade me that easily.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] This time, it's my turn to be the one that's bad at 
understanding, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Yup. Assuming that every single person will bless 
and support both of you...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] You're not that naive, right?
[FI] ......That's a lie.
[FI] Even if other people don't understand... I clearly do.
[FI] Even Kirino should have noticed.
[FI] After all, Manami has...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Manami, you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] !

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...Don't say anything unnecessary.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] You're her boyfriend, aren't you? You have to give 
all that kindness to Kirino-chan.
[FI] Manami has always, always been our ally, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I'm probably not the only person that will get in 
your way, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] So, you have to protect Kirino-chan.

[FI] There was never a point where she was our enemy, 
that would never happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hehe, good.
[FI] At times she was like a mother.
[FI] And at other times she was like a grandmother.
[FI] Like a little sister, like an older sister.
[FI] Like a true part of our family... our childhood friend.
[FI] She always only thought about us...
[FI] While putting aside her own wants and needs...
[FI] But... we can't rely on her anymore from now on.
[FI] We have to stand up and walk forward on our own.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kirino-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Please take care of Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Yeah...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Thank you, Manami-san.
[FI] We cried.
[FI] The tears wouldn't stop.

[FI] We had now flown away from our home, which 
had always warmly welcomed us.

[FI] The day when the three of us can laugh together 
like in the past is surely... far in the future.

[FI] At a time after countless days and months have 
passed and piled up.
